query: What distinct aspects of food quality do reviewers focus on?

per_column.name: facet_taste_flavor
per_column.rationale: Taste/flavor is a core intrinsic aspect of food quality.

per_column.name: facet_texture
per_column.rationale: Mouthfeel/texture is a constitutive sensory aspect of food quality.

per_column.name: facet_freshness
per_column.rationale: Freshness is an intrinsic quality dimension of the food itself.

per_column.name: facet_packaging
per_column.rationale: Packaging is a property of the product presentation, not an aspect of the food's quality itself; it can influence perception but is external to the food.

per_column.name: facet_value_price
per_column.rationale: Price/value is an economic attribute distinct from the food's intrinsic quality, not a part-of quality.

per_column.name: facet_health_nutrition
per_column.rationale: Nutritional/health properties are a legitimate intrinsic dimension of food quality.

per_column.name: facet_product_variety
per_column.rationale: Variety of product offerings is an assortment attribute, not a facet of the quality of a given food.

per_column.name: facet_consistency_reliability
per_column.rationale: Consistency of quality across purchases is a defensible quality dimension, though it partly overlaps with freshness/reliability.

per_column.name: facet_comparison_brand
per_column.rationale: Comparison to other brands is a rhetorical/relational move in a review, not a constitutive aspect of food quality.

per_column.name: facet_delivery_service
per_column.rationale: Delivery/service concerns the transaction and logistics, entirely external to the food's quality.

judge.rationale: Half of the added columns are genuine constitutive facets of food quality (taste/flavor, texture, freshness, health/nutrition, and arguably consistency), carving the sensory and intrinsic dimensions well and fairly exhaustively. However, the set is diluted by several external attributes that are not meronymic parts of food quality: packaging, value/price, product variety, brand comparison, and delivery/service belong to the broader consumer-experience or transactional space, not the food-quality concept itself. Mutual exclusivity is moderately weakened by overlap between consistency/reliability and freshness, and exhaustiveness is reduced because the presence of non-facets shows the decomposition targets the whole review experience rather than the quality concept alone.
